name: Culpeper County, Virginia (United States)
description: The Culpeper Minutemen flag: white with a coiled rattlesnake, the words THE CULPEPER MINUTE MEN on a scroll above, LIBERTY OR DEATH beside and DONT TREAD ON ME below, all in black.
history: Culpeper County is a county in the Piedmont of Virginia. Its official flag is the flag of the Culpeper Minutemen, the militia raised in 1775 which marched under the rattlesnake banner to the Battle of Great Bridge, the first Revolutionary battle on Virginia soil.

features.role: words THE CULPEPER MINUTE MEN, LIBERTY OR DEATH and DONT TREAD ON ME
